notes: Source is the official Lutron "product specifications" sheet, doc 3691127f (08.06.25), for model family HQP7-1/HQP7-2/HQP7-MDU-1/HQP7-MDU-2. This is a DIN-rail/panel-mounted low-voltage lighting control processor, not a rack-mount device (mounts inside an HQ-LV21, L-LV21, L-LV14, or PDx control panel), so rackUnits is omitted. Modeled the 2-link HQP7-2 variant (most complete I/O); the 1-link HQP7-1/HQP7-MDU-1 variants are identical but have only one Link terminal block instead of two, and MDU variants have reduced device/switch-leg capacity but the same physical connectors. All terminal-block connectors (power input and the L1/L2 links) are 4-pin removable/pluggable blocks - none are true bandwidth-graded connectors, so no grade field applies to them. Ethernet ports are plain RJ45; the spec states only "Ethernet" communications and Cat5e minimum cabling without an explicit 10/100/1000 Mbps rating, so grade was omitted per instructions rather than guessed. No USB, HDMI, video, or audio I/O exists on this device - it is a lighting/shading control processor, not an AV signal device, though it is commonly integrated into AV control racks.

ports.name: Ethernet 1
ports.note: One of two RJ45 standard Ethernet connections with built-in switch for daisy-chaining processors; Cat5e minimum, 100 m max run. Spec does not state link speed, so no grade is set.

ports.name: Ethernet 2
ports.note: Second RJ45 Ethernet connection (see Ethernet 1 note).

ports.name: Power Input (V+ / COM)
ports.note: 4-pin removable terminal block, Processor power 24-36 V DC 250 mA (SELV/NEC Class 2), fed from the separate QSPS-DH-1-75-H DIN-rail power supply. Terminals accept up to two 18 AWG wires each. Modeled as euroblock-dc since it is a pluggable screw/spring terminal block carrying low-voltage DC, not a barrel or IEC connector.

ports.name: Link 1 (L1)
ports.note: 4-pin removable terminal block (V+, COM, MUX, MUX) individually configurable as a HomeWorks QS wired device link or HomeWorks Clear Connect - Type A link; 24-36 V DC, 1 A. Carries both link power and RS-485-style MUX data, so it is not a pure power or pure data connector in the allowed list - closest match is a generic removable terminal block (euroblock). Present on HQP7-2/HQP7-MDU-2; HQP7-1/HQP7-MDU-1 have only Link 1.

ports.name: Link 2 (L2)
ports.note: Second 4-pin removable terminal block link, identical function/rating to Link 1. Only present on the 2-link models (HQP7-2, HQP7-MDU-2); the 1-link models (HQP7-1, HQP7-MDU-1) omit this port.
